AI-Augmented Data Analyst
About the role
As an AI-Augmented Data Analyst , you will make an impact by transforming complex data into actionable insights that support better decision-making across underwriting, claims, finance, and operational functions. You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences.
This role combines traditional analytics expertise with emerging AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, governance, and data quality.
In this role, you will:
+ Develop and optimize analytical solutions using Snowflake SQL and modern data analysis tools to support enterprise reporting and decision-making.
+ Perform exploratory data analysis on large structured and semi-structured datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
+ Build and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and reporting assets that support business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives.
+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business questions into measurable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
+ Apply AI-augmented analytics techniques to improve data exploration, pattern recognition, and insight generation while ensuring results are accurate, transparent, and business-relevant.
+ Develop reports, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations that communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Implement data quality controls, validation routines, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted analytical assets.
+ Document business rules, data lineage, analytical methodologies, and reporting logic to support governance and knowledge sharing.
+ Partner with data engineering teams to improve data availability, integration, performance, and analytic readiness.
+ Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance, operational effectiveness, customer behavior, and business strategy.
+ Promote responsible, ethical, and compliant use of data and AI-assisted analytics technologies.
Work model
We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants within the Eastern Time Zone (EST) . While Hartford, CT is the preferred location, qualified remote candidates located within EST will also be considered.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
What you need to have to be considered
+ 6+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, or related disciplines.
+ Strong expertise in Snowflake SQL, query optimization, and analytical data modeling.
+ Experience performing exploratory data analysis, trend analysis, statistical analysis, and business performance assessments.
+ Hands-on experience developing analytical datasets, reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
+ Experience working with structured and semi-structured data in cloud-based analytics environments.
+ Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, validation, and governance practices.
+ Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven recommendations.
+ Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to work independently in a distributed team environment while managing multiple priorities.
These will help you stand out
+ Experience in the Property & Casualty Insurance industry.
+ Knowledge of underwriting, claims, policy administration, pricing, actuarial analysis, or insurance operations.
+ Experience with AI-assisted analytics, augmented analytics, or Generative AI-enabled analytical tools.
+ Familiarity with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
+ Experience supporting regulatory reporting, operational performance measurement, and executive reporting initiatives.
+ Knowledge of cloud data platforms and modern analytics architectures.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.
Compensation
Applications will be accepted until November 20, 2026.
The annual salary for this position is between $115,000- $135,000 , depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other factors permitted by applicable law.
This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant's applicable compensation plans.
Pay Transparency
The salary range provided reflects Cognizant's good-faith estimate of compensation for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation offered will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs.
Cognizant is committed to providing competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our associates.
Benefits

+ Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
+ Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off
+ 401(k) Plan with Company Contributions
+ Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage
+ Paid Parental Leave
+ Employee Stock Purchase Plan
+ Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Programs
+ Training, Certification, and Professional Development Opportunities

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**What You Will Achieve**

  

Develop, maintain, and monitor activity-specific KPIs to evaluate key Medical Affairs activities, measure impact, and provide data-driven transparency on resource allocation

  

**How You Will Achieve It**

  

**Support KPI and analysis definition**

* Collaborate with Medical Impact and Outcomes team lead to ensure KPIs can be efficiently computed
* Support Medical Impact and Outcomes team lead for analyses strategic planning and insights communication

  

**Planning and conduct analytics**

* Develop and calculate metrics to evaluate Medical Affairs activities, impact, and resource allocation
* Analyze KPIs and data points to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can drive business outcomes
* Develop cascade of performance metrics that link assessment of individual and Category / Affiliate performance to overall Medical goals
* Support development of systems to monitor metrics and proactively identify underperformance or changes in particular areas of Medical Affairs activity
* Source and pull data from various systems and databases to populate the dashboards with accurate and up-to-date information
* Maintain tools and models according to best practices

  

**Data management**

* Gather, prepares, and maintains datasets required to perform analytics
* Oversee data systems holding in close collaboration with data mgmt. lead and ensure appropriate collection, storage, and processing of data within team
* Collaborate with Medical Affairs teams to support the efficient and timely reporting of data in appropriate formats and escalate roadblocks with leadership as necessary

  

**Collaborate with broader stakeholders**

* Advanced degree life sciences, data analytics or similar
* Strong experience (7+ years) data analytics, dashboard development / reporting

COMPANY

Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long-term financial stability.

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki https://www.linkedin.com/in/ed-harycki/, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017 https://techcrunch.com/2017/08/10/paypal-acquires-swift-financial/). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting-edge technology and customer-centric solutions.

Overview

Join our innovative Analytics team and help enable a world-class Marketing organization. As a Staff Marketing Data Analyst, you will serve as the dedicated analytics partner to Marketing, using data, measurement, and experimentation to improve customer acquisition, marketing efficiency, and business growth. You will independently own complex analyses and measurement frameworks, translate data into actionable recommendations, and help Marketing leaders understand what is working, why it is working, and where to invest next. The successful candidate will combine deep marketing analytics expertise, analytical rigor, and strong business judgment with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions without direct people-management responsibility.

What You'll Do

- Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and other teams to improve marketing data quality, align data requirements, and ensure measurement approaches are consistent and trusted.

- Independently lead actionable insights and deep-dive analyses that optimize customer acquisition, channel performance, campaign effectiveness, and marketing investment.

- Own and advance multi-touch attribution (MTA), marketing mix modeling (MMM), and other measurement approaches to evaluate ROI across paid media, organic, and other marketing channels.

- Design and scale experimentation approaches, including A/B testing and incrementality studies, to evaluate campaign effectiveness and inform investment decisions.

- Define, monitor, and interpret core marketing KPIs, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), and campaign ROI, to assess marketing efficiency and growth performance.

- Serve as a strategic thought partner to Marketing leaders, challenging assumptions and translating complex analytical findings into clear recommendations and business actions.

- Raise the analytical bar across the team by sharing best practices, improving measurement standards, and coaching peers on marketing analytics methods and decision-making.

Requirements

- 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, data analytics, or a related quantitative field, with demonstrated ownership of complex analytical work.

- Master's degree in Analytics, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a similar quantitative field.

- Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python or a similar analytical programming language.

- Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Sigma, Tableau, Looker or similar platforms.

- Deep understanding of marketing data, measurement, experimentation, and performance analysis, with demonstrated ability to independently translate insights into business action.

- Experience with paid media and acquisition channels, including channel performance metrics and measurement approaches.

- Hands-on knowledge of mobile app marketing analytics and MMPs, with AppsFlyer and SSOT experience strongly preferred.

- Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior Marketing partners and drive decisions through data without formal authority.

- Familiarity with modern data platforms and analytics workflows, such as Snowflake, AWS, dbt, or similar technologies.

BENEFITS AND PERKS

Our goal is to provide a comprehensive offering of benefits and perks that promote better financial, mental, and physical wellness.

We believe working alongside each other in person is the best way to build a great product and foster a strong company culture. Our expectation is that employees are in the office five days a week, allowing for optimal collaboration, inclusivity, and productivity. At the same time, we understand that life happens and recognize the importance of flexibility. We are committed to supporting our employees when circumstances arise that require remote work or adjusted schedules. Our goal is to ensure everyone can effectively balance personal and professional responsibilities while maintaining our collaborative and productive environment.

Here are some highlights of our benefits and perks offerings, feel free to ask your recruiting partner for more details on our comprehensive offering for employees.

- 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents on your first day of employment.

- Receive up to $100 per month in fitness reimbursement or enjoy a complimentary full membership to LifeTime Fitness or Equinox.

- 401(k) with a 3.5% match and immediate vesting

- Meal program available for both lunch and dinner

- Pre-tax benefits, including a $1,000 HSA match

- Life and accidental insurance

- Flexible PTO

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total compensation and rewards package at Credit Genie. You may also be eligible to participate in the bonus and equity programs. You will also have access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan with company match, short & long term disability insurance, life insurance, and flexible PTO along with many other benefits and perks.

Credit Genie is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer where we welcome and celebrate differences. We are committed to providing a workspace that is safe and inclusive, where everyone feels supported, connected, and inspired to do their best work. If you require any accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, please inform us of your needs when we contact you to schedule an interview.

kWantera is a venture-backed startup company dedicated to helping companies manage their energy. Our team of quantitative energy market analysts work with our big data analytics platform to analyze and react to changing market conditions. At kWantera, we promote a highly dedicated, collaborative and creative work environment where our employees take ownership of their role, taking much pride in their work. We aim to continue innovating in the future, giving businesses the upper hand on their energy decisions.

## Job Description

We are seeking for a candidate who is passionate about making a difference in energy industry using data analytics. Energy Data Analyst will act as a bridge between our data science team and the energy market. He/she will use data analysis techniques to find answers to research questions raised by data science team, will evaluate the challenges and opportunities in the market, backing the findings with solid statistics, and will evaluate and analyze our products' performance, providing insightful feedback for improvements, just to count a few of the responsibilities.

The ideal candidate is experienced and comfortable with analyzing big data and crunching numbers, is familiar with the electricity wholesale markets in the US, and has programming background, preferably in Python. We are seeking independent and critical thinkers, who are good team players.  

## Qualifications

* Strong background in data analytics. Must be familiar with basic statistical techniques and metrics, such as implementing and evaluating regression analysis, hypothesis testing, auto-correlation, probability distributions, graphical representations, as well as confusion matrices to evaluate accuracy, precision and error, etc. (Machine Learning background is a plus).
* Strong understanding of energy markets in US (Previous work experience in the energy domain, or extensive coursework and projects in the area)
* Familiarity with using Python for data analysis (or equivalent language).
* A strong sense of ownership
* A team player
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

## Additional Information

**COMPENSATION**

Very competitive salary, because you deserve it.

Equity in the company, to keep you motivated.

401(k) plan with matching, because we care about your future!

**PERKS:**  

Unlimited vacation, we work hard and take time when we need it.

Medical, dental and vision coverage.

Fully stocked fridge, coffee, espresso and tons of snacks to keep us going.

Fantastic modern office space in Pittsburgh’s Strip District with free parking.

Great office environment with exceptionally talented coworkers.

  

kWantera’s staff is highly motivated to shake up the status quo of the modern electric and natural gas industries within the United States. Our technology platform, machine learning, and predictive analytics are cutting-edge entrants into the emerging world of Big Data. We seek people who will be similarly passionate about changing the world.

This role will focus on analyzing data within Splunk, developing meaningful metrics, identifying trends, and creating reporting capabilities that provide actionable insight to security and operational stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience working with Splunk data, creating complex searches and dashboards, and transforming large volumes of vulnerability information into meaningful reporting. * Build advanced data models and correlation searches to bridge infrastructure-level logs with application-level visibility, supporting DoD cloud governance and reporting initiatives.
* Deliver actionable analytics and compliance reporting that tracks workload health, security posture, and remediation progress within defense cloud environments.
* Analyze vulnerability, security, application, and infrastructure data within Splunk.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and metrics that provide actionable cybersecurity insights.
* Create advanced Splunk searches, data models, and visualizations to support vulnerability management efforts.
* Identify trends, patterns, and emerging risks across enterprise vulnerability data.
* Develop methods to correlate vulnerabilities to applications, systems, business services, and mission functions.
* Improve visibility into vulnerability remediation efforts through tailored reporting and analytics.
* Work with cybersecurity, engineering, and operations teams to understand reporting requirements and develop solutions.
* Create executive-level and operational-level dashboards that communicate risk posture and remediation progress.
* Investigate data quality, data normalization, and reporting challenges to improve the accuracy and usefulness of metrics.
* Develop recurring and ad hoc reports supporting cybersecurity compliance and operational decision-making.
* Document search logic, reporting methodologies, dashboard designs, and analytic processes.
* Provide recommendations for improving vulnerability reporting, data categorization, and application-level visibility.

**Requirements**

* Active Secret Clearance required.
* IAT II (Security+) or higher-level certification required.
* Familiarity with DoD Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) and VDMS centralized logging and monitoring practices.
* Experience analyzing large-scale log datasets and security telemetry originating from enterprise defense cloud platforms.
* Strong experience working with Splunk in an analytics, reporting, cybersecurity, or operations environment.
* Strong experience creating Splunk searches, reports, dashboards, visualizations, and alerts.
* Experience analyzing cybersecurity and vulnerability management data.
* Understanding of vulnerability management concepts, CVEs, patch management, and remediation workflows.
* Experience working with large datasets and identifying trends, anomalies, and patterns.
* Ability to translate stakeholder requirements into meaningful metrics and reporting solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Splunk-related certification highly desired.

**CLASSIFICATION:** Non-exempt

  

**REPORTS TO:** Data Analyst Manager

  

**DATE:** September 16, 2026

  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Summary/Objective**

Responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering accurate, timely, and actionable reporting and analytics in support of all departments and divisions of the Bank. This position uses IBM Cognos, SQL, Python, and related data tools to extract, validate, analyze, and present information that supports business performance, operational efficiency, regulatory awareness, and management decision-making across the organization.

  

**Essential Functions** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

* Design, develop, maintain, and enhance recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, data extracts, and analytical deliverables using IBM Cognos, SQL, Python, and other approved reporting tools.
* Partner with business units across all departments and divisions of the Bank to understand reporting requirements, translate business needs into data solutions, and provide reliable reporting support.
* Write, optimize, and validate SQL queries to retrieve, join, and analyze data from enterprise data sources, data marts, and operational systems.
* Use Python, where appropriate, to automate data preparation, validation, analysis, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
* Develop and maintain IBM Cognos reports and packages, ensuring reports are accurate, efficient, well-documented, and aligned with business requirements.
* Validate data outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reasonableness; identify data quality issues and work with data owners, subject matter experts, and technology partners to resolve concerns.
* Prepare clear, concise reporting summaries and analyses that help management and business partners identify trends, monitor key metrics, and make informed decisions.
* Maintain reporting documentation, including report specifications, data definitions, source-to-report mapping, business rules, assumptions, and production schedules.
* Support regulatory, audit, compliance, finance, retail, commercial, operations, risk, and executive reporting needs as assigned.

**Other Duties**

* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to translate business questions into accurate reporting solutions.
* Works with general direction from the Data Analyst Manager and exercises sound judgment in prioritizing reporting requests, validating results, and escalating issues when appropriate.
* Proficiency with IBM Cognos report development, SQL querying, relational databases, data validation, and Python-based analysis or automation. Familiarity with banking data, financial reporting, business intelligence concepts, and data governance practices is preferred.
* Demonstrates informal leadership by promoting reporting standards, sharing data knowledge, and helping business partners use information effectively; this role does not have direct staff management responsibilities.
* Communicates technical information clearly to non-technical audiences and prepares reporting explanations, summaries, and recommendations appropriate for business users, managers, and senior leaders.
* Maintains the confidentiality, integrity, and appropriate use of customer, employee, financial, operational, and proprietary Bank data.
* Builds effective working relationships with stakeholders across all departments and divisions of the Bank, including business lines, operations, finance, risk, compliance, technology, and executive support functions.

**Supervisory Responsibility**

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities and does not manage any staff.

  

**Work Environment**

This job operates in an office setting, the opportunity to telework is not available. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Office environment with job duties conducted via telephone, face to face meetings, and on the computer.

  

**Physical Demands**

This position requires manual dexterity, the ability to lift files and open cabinets. This position requires bending, stooping, or standing, as necessary.

  

**Travel**

Limited local travel may be required for this position.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Two or more years of experience in data reporting, business intelligence, data analysis, financial services, or a related analytical role preferred.
* Experience developing reports or dashboards in IBM Cognos or a comparable business intelligence platform preferred.

  

Equal Employment Opportunity/M/F/disability/protected veteran status.

OHS Northeast Region GOH is a small management consulting firm supporting the federal government since 1997 ( www.gohnow.com ). SENIOR DATA ANALYST — WORKFORCE PLANNING
CenterWell Pharmacy, a Humana company
ABOUT THE ROLE
Every prescription CenterWell Pharmacy fills depends on a chain of people being in the right place at the right time. The Workforce Planning team makes sure that capacity exists before the demand arrives. The team conducts long-term forecasts that impact hiring, mid-term capacity plans that shape staffing strategy, and short-term plans that hold service levels week to week.
If you have done demand planning or S&OP for a physical supply chain, this is the same discipline — our constrained resource is licensed, trained people instead of inventory.
We are building this function from the ground up. The architecture, the metrics, and the tooling are not decided yet, and we are hiring two Senior Data Analysts to help decide them.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
+ Turn messy, multi-source operational data into planning inputs the business can act on
+ Partner with operations, finance, and department leaders to understand what they actually need to decide
+ Build the tooling and data products that let planners and leaders answer their own questions
+ Bring rigor to how we measure ourselves — forecast accuracy, capacity use, cost per prescription, and the drivers underneath them
TWO WAYS IN
Every analyst here shares the work above. Beyond it, you will anchor in one of two focus areas.
Focus Area 1 — Data Engineering & Architecture
You would own how planning data reaches the people who use it — the pipelines that consolidate workforce, volume, and operational data across platforms, and the models our forecasting tools run on. You have built ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud data environment (Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar), work fluently in Python, and know dimensional modeling and data warehouse design.
Focus Area 2 — Business Intelligence & Analytics
You would own how planning insight turns into decisions — the dashboards and self-service tools operations leaders run their business on, and the KPI definitions underneath them. You have advanced Power BI skills (or Tableau/Looker and willingness to switch), have built KPI frameworks from scratch, and can decompose a metric to root cause rather than reporting variance.
You do not need to be strong in both . We would rather have two people who are excellent at one than two who are adequate at everything. Tell us in your application which one is yours.
Use your skills to make an impact
Required Qualifications
+ 5 or more years of experience in analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, or a planning and forecasting function
+ Advanced SQL skills — you can write, tune, and debug complex queries against large operational datasets
+ Experience turning data into something a business partner actually used to make a decision
+ Experience explaining a technical result to a non-technical audience
+ Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, technical, or business discipline
Preferred Qualifications
+ Workforce planning, workforce management, or capacity planning experience to include — forecasting, scheduling, shrinkage, or occupancy
+ Prior experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, or S&OP in a distribution, fulfillment, manufacturing, or logistics environment
+ Healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry experience
